\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. Headquartered in Jackson, Michigan, Dawn Foods has more than 3,500 Team Members globally and provides high-quality bakery products to more than 50,000 customers located in more than 100 countries.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. Headquartered in Jackson, Michigan, Dawn Foods has more than 3,500 Team Members globally and provides high-quality bakery products to more than 50,000 customers located in more than 100 countries.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

{"response":"[{\"objectID\":\"cs9d9fff3ecf04cf45\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who is Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. Headquartered in Jackson, Michigan, Dawn Foods has more than 3,500 Team Members globally and provides high-quality bakery products to more than 50,000 customers located in more than 100 countries.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

{"response":"[{\"objectID\":\"cs9d9fff3ecf04cf45\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who is Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. Headquartered in Jackson, Michigan, Dawn Foods has more than 3,500 Team Members globally and provides high-quality bakery products to more than 50,000 customers located in more than 100 countries.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

{"response":"[{\"objectID\":\"cs9d9fff3ecf04cf45\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who is Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. Headquartered in Jackson, Michigan, Dawn Foods has more than 3,500 Team Members globally and provides high-quality bakery products to more than 50,000 customers located in more than 100 countries.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}

{"response":"[{\"objectID\":\"cs9d9fff3ecf04cf45\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who is Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is a global leader in bakery manufacturing and ingredients distribution. Headquartered in Jackson, Michigan, Dawn Foods has more than 3,500 Team Members globally and provides high-quality bakery products to more than 50,000 customers located in more than 100 countries.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4bd2bf4f0eb7dde3\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who owns Dawn Foods? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods is owned by the Jones Family and is a privately-held company.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd4a265b509f6d68a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Is Dawn Foods a publicly traded company?\",\"short_description\":\"

No. Dawn Foods is a family-owned business.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs9c65d300fec6a861\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods sell its products? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells products all across North America, Latin America, Europe & AMEAP. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs29a1acb1458f6b6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Where does Dawn Foods have distribution centers in the United States and Canada? \",\"short_description\":\"

For a full list of distribution locations for the United States and Canada, visit our Distribution page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs257c67be733cd9c0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn Foods donate products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes, Dawn Foods donates food products For more information, please visit our Corporate Giving page.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs479fc6dbb410ee20\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What kind of products does Dawn Foods Sell? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods sells a full line of bakery products to businesses including donut mix, cake mix, brownie mix, icing, glaze, fillings, and more. Visit our products page for more information on the products we sell.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs24b805e739b74608\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Who does Dawn Foods sell its products to? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn sells directly to bakeries, manufacturers, and distribution partners. For more information on the customers we partner with, visit our www.dawnfoods.com

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs760e5c3ff27e39db\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How does Dawn support DE&I? \",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn is committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace driven by our diverse backgrounds and unique perspectives. Click here to learn more about our approach to DE&I

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs84e3c3d92d2b4029\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I contact Dawn Foods?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods’s headquarters is located at 3333 Sargent Rd., Jackson, Michigan 49201. Please visit our Contact Us page for more information on how to connect with us.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs937ca3d02152a7df\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What are Dawn's office hours?\",\"short_description\":\"

To confirm hours, you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we’ll connect you with the distribution center servicing your area, or you can fill out our online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs68a4df3f92ebe308\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get more information about Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

To learn more about Dawn products, visit our products page or complete a contact form to have someone contact you. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb0cb913edb32470e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Can you send me a catalog of your products?\",\"short_description\":\"

As part of our sustainability efforts and to ensure our customers have the latest information on our products, we do not offer a printed catalog. Please visit our Products page or contact a Dawn sales professional who can provide you with more details on products available.  

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7386dbe3b82f9b5f\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How much do Dawn products cost?\",\"short_description\":\"

Pricing for Dawn products can be made available through a Dawn sales professional, or you can call us at 1-800-292-1362 and we can connect you with the distribution center servicing your area. You can also fill out a contact contact form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find pricing for our products.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csadc13dc59171bbd6\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"How can I get specifications like nutrition, kosher, COA and other documents for Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find all specification documents on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csd94401a644e8afc0\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any gluten-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods has taken our high standards and applied the principles of gluten-free baking to develop a line of easy-to-use bases that help you make delicious gluten-free cakes, cookies, muffins, creme cakes and more. Visit the Gluten-Free page to learn more.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs86464ed83e712cbe\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Does Dawn have any sugar-free or fat-free products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Dawn Foods produces sugar-free icings and cake bases and no-sugar-added fruit fillings. Learn more about our better-for-you products here. 

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs2c1396a4fe971cca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s bakery products kosher?\",\"short_description\":\"

Yes. Every Dawn Foods manufacturing plant in the United States is under kosher supervision. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for a copy of our kosher certificate or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the kosher certificates on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"csb242fabd142cde6e\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are your products plant based or animal based?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods facilities are kosher-certified and we do not use pork products. You can contact a Dawn sales professional to check individual products. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the ingredients for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4b5c26b53f438643\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Do you use GMOs?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods currently produces some non-GMO icings and fillings that are available for use in the UK and European Union.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs4a3b9c826f014e54\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"Are Dawn’s manufacturing facilities nut free?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn manufacturing plants in Jackson, MI, and Seattle, WA, are completely nut free. Our other U.S. manufacturing facilities have some nut-free lines, but all use nuts somewhere in the facility.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs338d6bd309b952c2\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the shelf life of Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Shelf life varies depending on the product. Please contact your Dawn sales professional for information on shelf life or fill out the online form to have someone contact you. If you have an account on dawnfoods.com, you can find the shelf life for each product on our product pages.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cscf592ce6b7237b8a\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What is the source of Dawn’s shortenings?\",\"short_description\":\"

Dawn Foods uses shortening that is mainly sourced from soybean and cottonseed oils or other vegetable sources. We do not use animal-based shortenings.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs7e0fa8a19d3f2c37\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"I currently make my own items, but my business is growing. Would it be possible for Dawn to start mass producing products for me?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please call us at 1-800-292-1362, and we’ll connect you with someone who can help. Or you can fill out an online form to have someone contact you.

\"},{\"objectID\":\"cs1bdfa00e710839ca\",\"tag\":[\"faq\"],\"type\":\"standard_page\",\"title\":\"What if I need help using Dawn products?\",\"short_description\":\"

Please contact your Dawn sales professional or fill out a contact form to have someone reach out to you. 

\"}]"}
